```{r setup}

# tidyverse
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r volcano, fig.height=3, fig.width=4}
df <- ikba_dea %>%
  filter(treatment == "IL1B") %>%
  mutate(log10FDR = -log10(FDR)) %>%
  mutate(log10FDR = if_else(is.infinite(log10FDR), 300, log10FDR))

summary <- df %>%
  group_by(time, condition) %>%
  summarize(
    n_ns = length(unique(Gene[sig == "ns"])),
    n_up = length(unique(Gene[sig == "up"])),
    n_dn = length(unique(Gene[sig == "dn"])),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # mutate(label = paste0(
  #   n_up, " up\n",
  #   n_dn, " down\n",
  #   n_ns, " ns"
  # ))
  mutate(label = paste0(
    n_up, " up\n",
    n_dn, " down"
  ))

ggplot(
  df,
  aes(x = log2fold, y = log10FDR)
) +
  facet_grid(
    condition~time,
    labeller = labeller(
      time = c("1" = "1h", "2" = "2h", "6" = "6h")
    )
    ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = sig),
    size = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("ns" = "grey30", "up" = "firebrick3", "dn" = "steelblue3")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    aspect.ratio = 0.8,
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = expression(log[2] * "fold"),
    y = expression(-log[10] * "FDR")
  )

# +
#   
#   geom_text(
#     data = summary,
#     aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
#     hjust = -0.1,
#     vjust = 1.1,
#     cex = 3
#   )

cleanup_objects()
```

```{r reconstruct kinetic clusters, fig.height=6, fig.width=3}
cluster_assignments <- read_rds("../results/figure2/cluster_assignments.rds")

df = ikba_dea %>%
  filter(treatment == "IL1B") %>%
  left_join(cluster_assignments, by = "Gene") %>%
  filter(!is.na(groupName))

ggplot(
  df,
  aes(x = time, y = log2fold, color = condition, group = condition)
) +
  facet_grid(
    shape~peak_sig,
    labeller = labeller(
      peak_sig = c(
        "up" = "upreg",
        "dn" = "downreg"
      )
    )
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    geom = "line",
    fun = "mean"
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "black",
    lwd = 0.5
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(3, -3)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("grey10", "aquamarine3", "orchid3")
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    expand = expansion(mult = 0.05)
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "time (h)",
    y = "log2fold"
  )
```

```{r reconstruct upregulated clusters only, fig.height=3, fig.width=4}
cluster_assignments <- read_rds("../results/figure2/cluster_assignments.rds")

df = ikba_dea %>%
  filter(treatment == "IL1B") %>%
  left_join(cluster_assignments, by = "Gene") %>%
  filter(!is.na(groupName)) %>%
  filter(peak_sig == "up")

ggplot(
  df,
  aes(x = time, y = log2fold, color = condition, group = condition)
) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~shape,
    scale = "free_x"
    ) +
  stat_summary(
    geom = "point",
    fun = "mean"
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    geom = "line",
    fun = "mean"
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "black",
    lwd = 0.5
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(3, -3)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("grey10", "aquamarine3", "orchid3")
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    expand = expansion(mult = 0.15)
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "time (h)",
    y = "log2fold"
  )
```
